content:
anna: FYI onboarding run with KestrelPay is hitting a preflight surge from their SPA. Multiple iframes + service worker all call sdk.init() on load. Seen steady 429s during demos.

anna: snippet from their client logs:
```
[2026-04-01T10:20:11Z] iframe-A init /v1/preflight 200
[2026-04-01T10:20:12Z] iframe-B init /v1/preflight 429 x 8
[2026-04-01T10:20:12Z] sw init  /v1/preflight 429 x 5
[2026-04-01T10:20:13Z] iframe-C init /v1/preflight 429 x 10
```

diego: Which SDK + auth pattern? Shared static key or ephemeral?

anna: Browser SDK v1.8.1, they wired a single dev API key into each frame for onboarding. No init splay.

sean: That's a textbook fanout. Quick customer-side suggestions: 1) only init non-visible frames on user interaction, 2) add randomized jitter before sdk.init(), 3) implement a per-origin inflight init guard. Example:```js
if (window.__RI_init) return;
const delay = 100 + Math.random()*900; // 100-1000ms jitter
setTimeout(()=> { window.__RI_init = true; sdk.init().finally(()=> window.__RI_init = false); }, delay);
```

diego: Also recommend ephemeral short-lived tokens per-frame. We can provide a tiny mint endpoint they can call from their backend to avoid sharing the server key.

anna: Can ops do anything server-side before they flip tokens?

sean: Ops options: enable tenant preflight_coalesce, bump burst_window temporarily, and apply a 2s leaky-bucket smoothing on preflight for their tenant. That should blunt the immediate 429s while they roll client changes.

rl-bot: RateLimitAlert: tenant="kestrelpay" window=2026-04-01T10:19:55Z..2026-04-01T10:22:00Z peak=152 req/min on /v1/preflight. Suggested: preflight_coalesce=true, burst_window=+180.

diego: I'll open an infra change with ttl=60m for burst bump + coalesce flag. Anna, can you confirm they can switch to ephemeral tokens today?

anna: Confirmed — engineering says yes. They'll do a short maintenance at 10:45 UTC and roll the token endpoint. I'll send the init-jitter snippet and the mint example.

sean: Post-rollout checklist: monitor 429 rate for 90 minutes, collect 5 init traces across origins, and verify auth header varies per frame (ephemeral token). If 429s persist after client-side splay + ephemeral tokens, escalate to runtime for batching/kernel analysis.

anna: Ticket updated and SE looped in. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
